title: Important: flute, libbase, libfonts, libformula, liblayout, libloader, libreoffice, librepository, libserializer, pentaho-libxml, pentaho-reporting-flow-engine, and sac security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description:
SAC is a standard interface for CSS parsers, intended to work with CSS1, CSS2, CSS3 and other CSS derived languages.

Security Fix(es):

* libreoffice: heap buffer overflow in PDF import stream handling (CVE-2026-63274)

* libreoffice: stack buffer overflow in CFF to Type 1 font conversion (CVE-2026-63276)

* libreoffice: stack buffer overflow in CFF font hint handling (CVE-2026-63275)

* libreoffice: libreoffice: Arbitrary code execution via remote Java database driver (CVE-2026-63277)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* [libbase] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275415)

* [flute] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275416)

* [libserializer] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275417)

* [libloader] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275418)

* [libformula] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275419)

* [librepository] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275420)

* [libfonts] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275421)

* [liblayout] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275422)

* [pentaho-libxml] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275423)

* [pentaho-reporting-flow-engine] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-275424)

* [sac] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-277813)

* [libreoffice] LibreOffice packages using EOL Java (after November 2026) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-260518)

* [Rocky Linux 8.10] Base Report Wizard fails with packaged Pentaho reporting engine (JIRA:Rocky Linux-286491)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
